| <code>eventId</code> | <code>string</code> | The EventId of the desired event/game for which to pull all betting markets (includes outcomes/bets). |
| <code>include?</code> | <code>[Include](src/models/include.ts)</code> | This parameter indicates which <code>BettingOutcome</code> records to return in the payload. By default, this endpoint only returns available outcomes, excluding the unlisted bets. <br><br><b>Important Note:</b> the default parameter of <code>available</code> is much faster and provides the best performance. Passing unlisted will return unlisted odds, but these are cached for much longer and may be several minutes old. For best performance, the default parameter is highly recommended. <br><br>Possible values include: <br><br><code>available</code> - excludes any betting outcomes that have been removed/unlisted by the respective sportsbook. This is more lightweight and delivers odds much faster than using unlisted. <br><br><code>unlisted</code> - includes the most recently available betting outcome per sportsbook, for each listed market, even those outcomes are expired/unlisted or otherwise unavailable from the respective sportsbook. This is a far heavier payload, and it's cached for much longer than available. <br><br> |

</dd>
</dl>

</dd>

</dd>

For best performance, the default parameter is highly recommended. <br><br>Possible values include: <br><br><code>available</code> - excludes any betting outcomes that have been removed/unlisted by the respective sportsbook. This is more lightweight and delivers odds much faster than using unlisted. <br><br><code>unlisted</code> - includes the most recently available betting outcome per sportsbook, for each listed market, even those outcomes are expired/unlisted or otherwise unavailable from the respective sportsbook. This is a far heavier payload, and it's cached for much longer than available. <br><br> |

### Parameters

<dd>

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code>format?</code> | <code>[Format](src/models/format.ts)</code> | Desired response format. Valid entries are <code>JSON</code> or <code>XML</code>. |
| <code>eventId</code> | <code>string</code> | The EventId of the desired event/game for which to pull all betting markets (includes outcomes/bets). Valid entries include: <code>134</code>, <code>155</code>, etc. |
| <code>include?</code> | <code>[Include](src/models/include.ts)</code> | This parameter indicates which <code>BettingOutcome</code> records to return in the payload. By default, this endpoint only returns available outcomes, excluding the unlisted bets. <br><br><b>Important Note:</b> the default parameter of <code>available</code> is much faster and provides the best performance. Passing unlisted will return unlisted odds, but these are cached for much longer and may be several minutes old. For best performance, the default parameter is highly recommended. <br><br>Possible values include: <br><br><code>available</code> - excludes any betting outcomes that have been removed/unlisted by the respective sportsbook. This is more lightweight and delivers odds much faster than using unlisted. <br><br><code>unlisted</code> - includes the most recently available betting outcome per sportsbook, for each listed market, even those outcomes are expired/unlisted or otherwise unavailable from the respective sportsbook. This is a far heavier payload, and it's cached for much longer than available. <br><br> |

</dd>
</dl>

<dl>
<dd>

**OnSuccess**: <code>[BettingMarket](src/models/betting-market.ts)[]</code>

</dd>
</dl>

### Description

<dl>
<dd>

This works in the same way as Betting Markets by Market Type but is prefiltered to the Player Props type only. Ideal if your application will only ever require Player Props, but if you also want Team Props etc. it is recommended to use the by Market Type endpoint.

</dd>
</dl>

### Usage

<dl>
<dd>

```ts

} catch (err) {
  if (
    err instanceof NbaV3Odds.NbaV3OddsBettingPlayerPropsByGameError && err.payload.kind === "unauthorized"
  ) {
    // TODO: Handle 'err.payload.body' of type Unauthorized
  }
}
```

</dd>
</dl>

### Parameters

<dl>
<dd>

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code>format?</code> | <code>[Format](src/models/format.ts)</code> | Desired response format. Valid entries are <code>JSON</code> or <code>XML</code>. |
| <code>gameId</code> | <code>string</code> | The unique GameID of the game in question. |
| <code>include?</code> | <code>[Include](src/models/include.ts)</code> | This parameter indicates which <code>BettingOutcome</code> records to return in the payload. By default, this endpoint only returns available outcomes, excluding the unlisted bets. <br><br><b>Important Note:</b> the default parameter of <code>available</code> is much faster and provides the best performance. Passing unlisted will return unlisted odds, but these are cached for much longer and may be several minutes old. For best performance, the default parameter is highly recommended. <br><br>Possible values include: <br><br><code>available</code> - excludes any betting outcomes that have been removed/unlisted by the respective sportsbook. This is more lightweight and delivers odds much faster than using unlisted. <br><br><code>unlisted</code> - includes the most recently available betting outcome per sportsbook, for each listed market, even those outcomes are expired/unlisted or otherwise unavailable from the respective sportsbook. This is a far heavier payload, and it's cached for much longer than available. <br><br> |

</dd>
</dl>

### Response

<dl>
<dd>

**OnSuccess**: <code>[BettingMarket](src/models/betting-market.ts)[]</code>

**OnError**: <code>[NbaV3Odds.NbaV3OddsBettingPlayerPropsByGameError](src/resources/nba-v3-odds.ts)</code>

</dd>
</dl>

</dd>
</dl>

| <code>include?</code> | <code>[Include](src/models/include.ts)</code> | This parameter indicates which <code>BettingOutcome</code> records to return in the payload. By default, this endpoint only returns available outcomes, excluding the unlisted bets. <br><br><br><br><b>Important Note:</b> the default parameter of available is much faster and provides the best performance. Passing unlisted will return unlisted odds, but these are cached for much longer and may be several minutes old. For best performance, the default parameter is highly recommended. <br><br><br><br>Possible values include: <br><br><br><code>available</code> - excludes any betting outcomes that have been removed/unlisted by the respective sportsbook. This is more lightweight and delivers odds much faster than using unlisted. <br><br><br><code>unlisted</code> - includes the most recently available betting outcome per sportsbook, for each listed market, even those outcomes are expired/unlisted or otherwise unavailable from the respective sportsbook. This is a far heavier payload, and it's cached for much longer than available. <br><br> |

<dl>
<dd>

### Description

<dl>
<dd>

Returns the markets of all available types (e.g. Player Props, Team Props) and available outcomes for a given BettingEventID.

</dd>
</dl>

### Usage

<dl>
<dd>

```ts
try {
  const response = await client.nhlV3Odds.nhlV3OddsBettingMarketsByEvent({ eventId });
  // TODO: Handle 'response' of type BettingMarket[]
} catch (err) {
  if (err instanceof NhlV3Odds.NhlV3OddsBettingMarketsByEventError && err.payload.kind === "unauthorized") {
    // TODO: Handle 'err.payload.body' of type Unauthorized
  }
}
```

</dd>
</dl>

### Parameters

<dl>
<dd>

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code>format?</code> | <code>[Format](src/models/format.ts)</code> | Desired response format. Valid entries are <code>JSON</code> or <code>XML</code>. |
| <code>eventId</code> | <code>string</code> | The EventId of the desired event/game for which to pull all betting markets (includes outcomes/bets). Valid entries include: <code>134</code>, <code>155</code>, etc. |
| <code>include?</code> | <code>[Include](src/models/include.ts)</code> | This parameter indicates which <code>BettingOutcome</code> records to return in the payload. By default, this endpoint only returns available outcomes, excluding the unlisted bets. <br><br><b>Important Note:</b> the default parameter of <code>available</code> is much faster and provides the best performance. Passing unlisted will return unlisted odds, but these are cached for much longer and may be several minutes old. For best performance, the default parameter is highly recommended. <br><br>Possible values include: <br><br><code>available</code> - excludes any betting outcomes that have been removed/unlisted by the respective sportsbook. This is more lightweight and delivers odds much faster than using unlisted. <br><br><code>unlisted</code> - includes the most recently available betting outcome per sportsbook, for each listed market, even those outcomes are expired/unlisted or otherwise unavailable from the respective sportsbook. This is a far heavier payload, and it's cached for much longer than available. <br><br> |

</dd>
</dl>

### Response

<dl>
<dd>

**OnSuccess**: <code>[BettingMarket](src/models/betting-market.ts)[]</code>

**OnError**: <code>[NhlV3Odds.NhlV3OddsBettingMarketsByEventError](src/resources/nhl-v3-odds.ts)</code>

</dd>
</dl>

</dd>
</dl>

</details>

By default, this endpoint only returns available outcomes, excluding the unlisted bets. <br><br><b>Important Note:</b> the default parameter of <code>available</code> is much faster and provides the best performance. Passing unlisted will return unlisted odds, but these are cached for much longer and may be several minutes old. For best performance, the default parameter is highly recommended. <br><br>Possible values include: <br><br><code>available</code> - excludes any betting outcomes that have been removed/unlisted by the respective sportsbook. This is more lightweight and delivers odds much faster than using unlisted. <br><br><code>unlisted</code> - includes the most recently available betting outcome per sportsbook, for each listed market, even those outcomes are expired/unlisted or otherwise unavailable from the respective sportsbook. This is a far heavier payload, and it's cached for much longer than available. <br><br> |

<dl>
<dd>

### Description

<dl>
<dd>

Returns the markets of all available types (e.g. Player Props, Team Props) and available outcomes for a given BettingEventID.

</dd>
</dl>

### Usage

<dl>
<dd>

```ts
try {
  const response = await client.cfbV3Odds.cfbV3OddsBettingMarketsByEvent({ eventId });
  // TODO: Handle 'response' of type BettingMarket[]
} catch (err) {
  if (err instanceof CfbV3Odds.CfbV3OddsBettingMarketsByEventError && err.payload.kind === "unauthorized") {
    // TODO: Handle 'err.payload.body' of type Unauthorized
  }
}
```

</dd>
</dl>

### Parameters

<dl>
<dd>

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code>format?</code> | <code>[Format](src/models/format.ts)</code> | Desired response format. Valid entries are <code>JSON</code> or <code>XML</code>. |
| <code>eventId</code> | <code>string</code> | The EventId of the desired event/game for which to pull all betting markets (includes outcomes/bets). |
| <code>include?</code> | <code>[Include](src/models/include.ts)</code> | This parameter indicates which <code>BettingOutcome</code> records to return in the payload. By default, this endpoint only returns available outcomes, excluding the unlisted bets. <br><br><b>Important Note:</b> the default parameter of <code>available</code> is much faster and provides the best performance. Passing unlisted will return unlisted odds, but these are cached for much longer and may be several minutes old. For best performance, the default parameter is highly recommended. <br><br>Possible values include: <br><br><code>available</code> - excludes any betting outcomes that have been removed/unlisted by the respective sportsbook. This is more lightweight and delivers odds much faster than using unlisted. <br><br><code>unlisted</code> - includes the most recently available betting outcome per sportsbook, for each listed market, even those outcomes are expired/unlisted or otherwise unavailable from the respective sportsbook. This is a far heavier payload, and it's cached for much longer than available. <br><br> |

</dd>
</dl>

### Response

<dl>
<dd>

**OnSuccess**: <code>[BettingMarket](src/models/betting-market.ts)[]</code>

**OnError**: <code>[CfbV3Odds.CfbV3OddsBettingMarketsByEventError](src/resources/cfb-v3-odds.ts)</code>

</dd>
</dl>

</dd>
</dl>

</details>

| <code>include?</code> | <code>[Include](src/models/include.ts)</code> | This parameter indicates which <code>BettingOutcome</code> records to return in the payload. By default, this endpoint only returns available outcomes, excluding the unlisted bets. <br><br><b>Important Note:</b> the default parameter of <code>available</code> is much faster and provides the best performance. Passing unlisted will return unlisted odds, but these are cached for much longer and may be several minutes old. For best performance, the default parameter is highly recommended. <br><br>Possible values include: <br><br><code>available</code> - excludes any betting outcomes that have been removed/unlisted by the respective sportsbook. This is more lightweight and delivers odds much faster than using unlisted. <br><br><code>unlisted</code> - includes the most recently available betting outcome per sportsbook, for each listed market, even those outcomes are expired/unlisted or otherwise unavailable from the respective sportsbook. This is a far heavier payload, and it's cached for much longer than available. <br><br> |

</dd>

</dd>

### Description

<dd>

### Usage

<dl>
<dd>

```ts

  const response = await client.cbbV3Odds.cbbV3OddsBettingMarketsByEvent({ eventId });
  // TODO: Handle 'response' of type BettingMarket[]
} catch (err) {
  if (err instanceof CbbV3Odds.CbbV3OddsBettingMarketsByEventError && err.payload.kind === "unauthorized") {
    // TODO: Handle 'err.payload.body' of type Unauthorized
  }
}
```

</dd>

### Parameters

<dl>
<dd>

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code>format?</code> | <code>[Format](src/models/format.ts)</code> | Desired response format. Valid entries are <code>JSON</code> or <code>XML</code>. |
| <code>eventId</code> | <code>string</code> | The EventId of the desired event/game for which to pull all betting markets (includes outcomes/bets). |
| <code>include?</code> | <code>[Include](src/models/include.ts)</code> | This parameter indicates which <code>BettingOutcome</code> records to return in the payload. By default, this endpoint only returns available outcomes, excluding the unlisted bets. <br><br><br><br><b>Important Note:</b> the default parameter of <code>available</code> is much faster and provides the best performance. Passing unlisted will return unlisted odds, but these are cached for much longer and may be several minutes old. For best performance, the default parameter is highly recommended. <br><br><br><br>Possible values include: <br><br><br><code>available</code> - excludes any betting outcomes that have been removed/unlisted by the respective sportsbook. This is more lightweight and delivers odds much faster than using unlisted. <br><br><br><code>unlisted</code> - includes the most recently available betting outcome per sportsbook, for each listed market, even those outcomes are expired/unlisted or otherwise unavailable from the respective sportsbook. This is a far heavier payload, and it's cached for much longer than available. <br><br> |

</dd>
</dl>

<dl>
<dd>

**OnSuccess**: <code>[BettingMarket](src/models/betting-market.ts)[]</code>

**OnError**: <code>[CbbV3Odds.CbbV3OddsBettingMarketsByEventError](src/resources/cbb-v3-odds.ts)</code>

</dd>
</dl>

This is more lightweight and delivers odds much faster than using unlisted. <br><br><br><code>unlisted</code> - includes the most recently available betting outcome per sportsbook, for each listed market, even those outcomes are expired/unlisted or otherwise unavailable from the respective sportsbook. This is a far heavier payload, and it's cached for much longer than available. <br><br> |

</dd>
</dl>

<dl>
<dd>

### Description

<dl>

This is more lightweight and delivers odds much faster than using unlisted. <br><br><code>unlisted</code> - includes the most recently available betting outcome per sportsbook, for each listed market, even those outcomes are expired/unlisted or otherwise unavailable from the respective sportsbook. This is a far heavier payload, and it's cached for much longer than available. <br><br> |

</dd>

<dl>
<dd>

### Description

<dl>
<dd>

Returns the markets of all available types (e.g. Player Props, Team Props) and available outcomes for a given BettingEventID.

</dd>
</dl>

### Usage

<dl>
<dd>

```ts
try {
  const response = await client.nascarV3Odds.nascarV3OddsBettingMarketsByEvent({ eventId });
  // TODO: Handle 'response' of type BettingMarket3[]
} catch (err) {
  if (
    err instanceof NascarV3Odds.NascarV3OddsBettingMarketsByEventError && err.payload.kind === "unauthorized"
  ) {
    // TODO: Handle 'err.payload.body' of type Unauthorized
  }
}
```

</dd>
</dl>

### Parameters

<dl>
<dd>

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code>format?</code> | <code>[Format](src/models/format.ts)</code> | Desired response format. Valid entries are <code>JSON</code> or <code>XML</code>. |
| <code>eventId</code> | <code>string</code> | The EventId of the desired event/game for which to pull all betting markets (includes outcomes/bets). |
| <code>include?</code> | <code>[Include](src/models/include.ts)</code> | This parameter indicates which <code>BettingOutcome</code> records to return in the payload. By default, this endpoint only returns available outcomes, excluding the unlisted bets. <br><br><b>Important Note:</b> the default parameter of <code>available</code> is much faster and provides the best performance. Passing unlisted will return unlisted odds, but these are cached for much longer and may be several minutes old. For best performance, the default parameter is highly recommended. <br><br>Possible values include: <br><br><code>available</code> - excludes any betting outcomes that have been removed/unlisted by the respective sportsbook. This is more lightweight and delivers odds much faster than using unlisted. <br><br><code>unlisted</code> - includes the most recently available betting outcome per sportsbook, for each listed market, even those outcomes are expired/unlisted or otherwise unavailable from the respective sportsbook. This is a far heavier payload, and it's cached for much longer than available. <br><br> |

</dd>
</dl>

<dl>
<dd>

**OnSuccess**: <code>[BettingMarket3](src/models/betting-market3.ts)[]</code>

**OnError**: <code>[NascarV3Odds.NascarV3OddsBettingMarketsByEventError](src/resources/nascar-v3-odds.ts)</code>

</dd>
</dl>

</dd>
</dl>

<dl>
<dd>

### Description

<dl>
<dd>

This works in the same way as Betting Markets by Market Type but is prefiltered to the Player (Fighter) Props type only. Ideal if your application will only ever require Player Props, but if you also want Fight Props etc. it is recommended to use the by Market Type endpoint.

</dd>
</dl>

### Usage

<dl>
<dd>

```ts
try {
  const response = await client.mmaV3Odds.mmaV3OddsBettingFighterPropsByEvent({ eventId });
  // TODO: Handle 'response' of type BettingMarket4[]
} catch (err) {
  if (
    err instanceof MmaV3Odds.MmaV3OddsBettingFighterPropsByEventError && err.payload.kind === "unauthorized"
  ) {
    // TODO: Handle 'err.payload.body' of type Unauthorized
  }
}
```

</dd>
</dl>

### Parameters

<dl>
<dd>

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code>format?</code> | <code>[Format](src/models/format.ts)</code> | Desired response format. Valid entries are <code>JSON</code> or <code>XML</code>. |
| <code>eventId</code> | <code>string</code> | The top level EventId for the event (i.e. UFC 250).  Distinct from the BettingEventId. |
| <code>include?</code> | <code>[Include](src/models/include.ts)</code> | This parameter indicates which <code>BettingOutcome</code> records to return in the payload. By default, this endpoint only returns available outcomes, excluding the unlisted bets. <br><br><br><br><b>Important Note:</b> the default parameter of available is much faster and provides the best performance. Passing unlisted will return unlisted odds, but these are cached for much longer and may be several minutes old. For best performance, the default parameter is highly recommended. <br><br><br><br>Possible values include: <br><br><br><code>available</code> - excludes any betting outcomes that have been removed/unlisted by the respective sportsbook. This is more lightweight and delivers odds much faster than using unlisted. <br><br><br><code>unlisted</code> - includes the most recently available betting outcome per sportsbook, for each listed market, even those outcomes are expired/unlisted or otherwise unavailable from the respective sportsbook. This is a far heavier payload, and it's cached for much longer than available. <br><br> |

</dd>
</dl>

### Response

<dl>
<dd>

**OnSuccess**: <code>[BettingMarket4](src/models/betting-market4.ts)[]</code>

**OnError**: <code>[MmaV3Odds.MmaV3OddsBettingFighterPropsByEventError](src/resources/mma-v3-odds.ts)</code>

</dd>
</dl>

</dd>
</dl>

Passing unlisted will return unlisted odds, but these are cached for much longer and may be several minutes old. For best performance, the default parameter is highly recommended. <br><br>Possible values include: <br><br><code>available</code> - excludes any betting outcomes that have been removed/unlisted by the respective sportsbook. This is more lightweight and delivers odds much faster than using unlisted. <br><br><code>unlisted</code> - includes the most recently available betting outcome per sportsbook, for each listed market, even those outcomes are expired/unlisted or otherwise unavailable from the respective sportsbook. This is a far heavier payload, and it's cached for much longer than available. <br><br> |
